test_3_local_global.finding: No logical contradiction. Standard quantum contextuality — different measurements reveal complementary properties. Ontological strangeness, not logical inconsistency.

test_4_physical_realizability.name: Attosecond Shutter Feasibility
test_4_physical_realizability.method: Technology assessment: attosecond gating (Nobel 2023) vs optical period
test_4_physical_realizability.finding: Attosecond shutters exist. Multi-photon probabilities extremely small (~10⁻⁶) but non-zero. 'Infinite' is formal limit; realistic predictions challenging but not impossible.
test_4_physical_realizability.key_metric: P(n>1) with 100-as shutter: ~10⁻⁶; optical period: ~2.7 fs

core_claim: Truncating a single-photon wave packet with an ultrafast shutter produces a superposition over all photon-number Fock states (0 to infinity), not a shortened photon or simple 0/1 mixture. Locally: single-photon on one side, vacuum on the other. Globally: infinite Fock superposition.
